description: Caption gallery tile samples (doc/spec/captions.md sections 15.2 and 15.3) for a project, a scope (null for the full take, else a clip id), a library style, the playhead in the scope's edited time and the Settings switch. The words are the caption page at the playhead (section 6.1 paging with project overrides only for the selected tile, without the 6.2 fit), the next page in a gap or before the first page, the last page after it, or the style's preview.text when the scope has no caption words or words are hidden. They are timed [0.4 i, 0.4 i + 0.35] with the text as stored and no emphasis; duration is 0.4 n + 0.5. time is 0.35 x 0.98 into the word the playhead is in; otherwise the caption card's drawn moment (doc/design.md section 5.4.2); for preview.text, 0.4 a + 0.35 min(progress, 0.98) with a = min(activeWord, n - 1) and progress 1 when absent.
